import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/decompress_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
# Extract a few jpg files
count = 0
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.jpg') and count < 5:
        data = z.read(n)
        with open(f'/tmp/seed_{count}.jpg', 'wb') as f:
            f.write(data)
        print(f'{n}: {len(data)} bytes')
        count += 1
"
